summary: LunaWise is an interactive web platform designed to help space scientists and researchers discover and evaluate promising candidate sites for establishing human bases on the Moon and Mars. By organizing key spatial, environmental, and geological site information into an accessible interface, LunaWise enables researchers to compare regions and assess suitability factors critical to future habitats. Streamlining site discovery and exploration helps accelerate mission planning and supports sustainable human presence beyond Earth
details:
What It Does & How It Works LunaWise is an interactive web platform that helps space scientists explore and evaluate potential sites for establishing human bases on the Moon and Mars. It centralizes key environmental, geographical, and geological data into a clear interface so researchers can easily browse and compare candidate regions.

screenshot.png+ 1

Benefits & Intended Impact By organizing scattered planetary site data in one place, LunaWise saves research time, simplifies early-stage site comparison, and helps mission planners identify safe, resource-rich locations for future lunar and Martian habitats.

screenshot.png

Tools & Technologies Used

  • Development: Web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) with AI assistance for coding, debugging, and troubleshooting.
    screenshot.png
  • Design: Canva (for UI visuals and presentation materials).
    screenshot.png
  • Data: NASA and space agency planetary resources.
    screenshot.png

Creativity & Key Factors Considered Unlike single-planet tools, LunaWise unites Moon and Mars base exploration in one accessible platform. Our team prioritized usability for researchers and focused on critical habitability factors—including terrain safety, environmental conditions, and local resource availability.
